title: Olive Tree Bible App skill roadmap

beginner.title: Get started with Olive Tree Bible App
beginner.outcome: You can: set up Olive Tree Bible App, find your way around and finish a first small task
beginner.practice: Complete the official getting-started guide, then one small real task from your work

beginner.title: Read and search
beginner.outcome: You can: find and read passages

intermediate.title: Cross-references and context
intermediate.practice: Trace a theme across five passages

intermediate.title: Original languages
intermediate.outcome: You can: look beneath the translation
intermediate.practice: Do a word study on one key term

intermediate.title: Signature skills in Olive Tree Bible App
intermediate.outcome: You can: use the features that make Olive Tree Bible App distinctive
intermediate.practice: Use each of these features once on a real piece of work

expert.title: Advanced Olive Tree Bible App
expert.outcome: You can: use Olive Tree Bible App's advanced capabilities with confidence
expert.practice: Complete a project that needs at least two of these advanced capabilities

expert.title: Prepare teaching
expert.outcome: You can: turn study into teaching
expert.practice: Prepare a study guide for a small group

expert.title: Integrate Olive Tree Bible App into your workflow
expert.outcome: You can: connect Olive Tree Bible App with the other tools you use
expert.practice: Connect Olive Tree Bible App to one other tool you use and remove one manual step

expert.title: Lead and teach others
expert.outcome: You can: set standards and teach others to use Olive Tree Bible App well
expert.practice: Write a one-page "how we use Olive Tree Bible App" guide and teach it to one person

expert_validation.note: Generated from the archetype template plus tool-specific signature skills; to be reviewed by a practitioner.
